articles.text: LIÚ LǍOSHĪ: Nǐ shi Fāng Bǎolán Tóngzhì ma?
TEACHER LIÚ: Are you Comrade Fāng Bǎolán?
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Shì. Nín guìxìng?
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Yes. May I ask your name?
LIÚ LǍOSHĪ: Wǒ xìng Liú, shi Gāo Xiǎohuáde Tóngzhì zài yèdàde lǎoshī.
TEACHER LIÚ: My name is Liú. I'm Comrade Gāo Xiǎohuá's teacher at the evening university.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Ō, shi Xiǎohuáde lǎoshī. Kuài qǐng jìnlai zuò.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Oh, Xiǎohuá's teacher! Please come in and sit down.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Liú Lǎoshī, Xiǎohuá zài yèdà zěnmeyàng a?
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: How is Xiǎohuá doing in the evening university, Teacher Liú?
LIÚ LǍOSHĪ: Xiǎohuá hěn yònggōng, xuéxíde hěn hǎo. Kěshi wǒ zǒng juéde Xiǎohuá shēntǐ bú gòu hǎo. Měitian dōu hǎoxiàng hěn lèi, shì bu shì shuìde bú gòu?

TEACHER LIÚ: Xiǎohuá is very hardworking and does very well in her studies, but it does seem to me that her health is not good enough. She seems tired every day. Is it because she doesn't get enough sleep?
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Yìdiǎnr dōu bú cuò, shi xiūxide bú gòu. Zhèi háizi měitian huílai niàn shū dōu děi niàn dào liǎng-sāndiǎn zhōng.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Absolutely right. She doesn't get enough rest. Every day the child comes home and studies until two or three o'clock.
LIÚ LǍOSHĪ: Xiànzàide niánqīng rén zhèiyang niàn shū shi yǒu yuányīnde.
TEACHER LIÚ: There's a good reason for the way young people study now.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Shéi shuō bú shì ne?
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: That's for sure!

FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Shínián lái xuéxiàode qíngxing tài bù xiàng huà le. Nèi shíhou háizimen niànbuliǎo shū, cānjiāle Hóngwèibīng, yìtiān dào wǎn zài wàibianr pǎolái pǎoqù, shénme yě méi xuéhuì. Xiànzài cānjiāle gōngzuò, zài bú niàn shū, zěnme néng bǎ gōngzuò zuòhǎo ne?

FĀNG BǍOLÁN: For the past ten years conditions in the schools have been unspeakable. During that time, students couldn't study. They joined the Red Guards and were out running around from morning till night. They didn't learn a thing. Now that they are participating in work, if they go on without studying, how can they do their work well?

LIÚ LǍOSHĪ: Kěshi, shíniánde shū bú shi shítiān bànyuè kěyi niànwánde. Wǒmen zuò lǎoshīde, zuò fùmǔde hái děi bǎohù tāmende jiànkāng. Bù néng ràng tāmen tài lèi le. Nǐmen Xiǎohuá měitian yídìng yào zǎo diǎnr xiūxi.

TEACHER LIÚ: But you can't complete ten years of study in ten days or half a month. Those of us who are teachers and parents still must protect their health. We can't let them get too tired. Your Xiǎohuá must go to bed earlier.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Zhēn xièxie nín. Nín huíqu yǐhòu yě tì wǒmen xièxie gōngchǎng hé yèdàde lǐngdǎo.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Thank you very much. When you get back, thank the leadership at the factory and the evening university.
LIÚ LǍOSHĪ: Bú kèqi. Zhèixiē dōu shi wǒmen yīnggāi zuòde.
TEACHER LIÚ: Not at all. All this is what we should be doing.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Wǒ yě huì zhàogu Xiǎohuá, ràng ta hǎohāor gōngzuò, hǎohāor xuéxí.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: And I'll take care of Xiǎohuá, and see that she works well and studies well.
LIÚ LǍOSHĪ: Hǎo, wǒ zǒule. Zàijiàn!
TEACHER LIÚ: All right. I'll be on my way. Good-bye.
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Zàijiàn! Yǒu kòngr lái zuò a!
FĀNG BǍOLÁN: Good-bye. When you have time, come over and sit a while.
